provenance.construction: manually derived from the supplied Mystery 4-operator STRIPS domain and domain NL

direct_pddl_instructions: This is an untyped STRIPS domain. Declare every entity as an untyped object name and use only province/1, planet/1, harmony/0, pain/1, and craves/2.
province, planet, and pain are dynamic unary state facts, not PDDL object types. Preserve them exactly in INIT or GOAL when stated.
harmony is a zero-arity fact and must be rendered exactly as (harmony), with no object argument.
Use (craves CRAVER DESIRED-ENTITY): the first argument is the entity that craves and the second is what it craves. Never reverse these roles.
The English labels are benchmark symbols whose meanings are defined by Domain NL. Do not replace them with ordinary-language or standard BlocksWorld predicates.

province_state.description: an entity currently having the benchmark state called province

planet_state.description: an entity currently having the benchmark state called planet

global_harmony.description: the zero-argument global condition called harmony currently holding

pain_state.description: an entity currently having the benchmark state called pain

craving_relation.description: one entity craving another entity, ordered as craver then desired entity

predicates.name: craves
predicates.direct_pddl_instruction: Emit craves(X,Y) when X craves Y; keep X in slot 1 and Y in slot 2.
